breakdown.description: Inviscid (zero viscosity) is incompatible with diffusion flame which relies on viscous/diffusive transport. The simulation must use sutherland transport, not zero viscosity.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. While it correctly included the instruction 'Use Sutherland transport model', it also added the contradictory and physically incorrect instruction 'Set viscosity to 0 throughout the domain'. The Sutherland model is used to calculate a temperature-dependent viscosity; setting viscosity to zero makes the simulation inviscid, which is the exact error that needed to be corrected for a diffusion flame simulation.
